searchText: I can also join right? I am still at `Project Discovery` stage trying to make the documentation publicly consumable, which is not currently. Call is open for anyone to join. office hours: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85696935224?pwd=OStXUlgvdFlqWVNvVlJiRjdDZTRjdz09 <@&857649635274915900> **Only 1 week left** (Nov 15) to write up your showcase profile if you participated in the first cohort! we'll be giving out a POAP for anyone who submits This is important for wrapping your participation in the program & informing how we approach future cohorts. Please do it soon - especially if you received funding support 🙏 Kudos to <@!147269256042643456> for being the first Add yours here: https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-zero/tree/main/showcase Whats the due date? nov. 15 Even if you are already employed/found a job/etc. it's useful to have these for future CDAP participants who can see the accomplishments of folks in the program 😄 Thanks for the session 🙏 Got to explore more on the following : * Ethereum Node Records (ENR) * Beacon Chains * networking-portal * https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis attending the zoom sessions from the Ethereum community has been really helpful for a newbie like me. Even If I don't get the full gist of things I get some key pointers to explore and study 🚀
